prompt:
Create a production sprite atlas for the SAME Xiaohan white Samoyed desktop pet from these three references (puppy, teen, adult). Preserve each age's proportions and exact costume, warm cream-white fur, delicate hand-painted storybook outlines, black nose/eyes, gentle non-scary expression and curled fluffy tail. Small triangular ears are upright or swept BACK, NEVER floppy hanging down. GENUINE fully transparent RGBA background, zero-alpha empty gutters; no white paper, floor, backdrop, shadows, labels or grid. 3 equally wide columns x 6 equally high rows, EXACTLY 18 separated full-body sprites, each wholly inside cell with ample margin. Columns puppy, teen, adult; relative age size is as in references. Front three-quarter facing slightly LEFT throughout. Body size and ground baseline consistent across paired frames. No bowls, food, toys, keyboard, or other props. These are mild needs in a cozy pet game, no injuries or emaciation.
ROWS1-2 HUNGRY two-frame idle: sitting upright but hunched slightly, head lowered, pleading upward eyes, mouth closed, one front paw lightly drawn inward. Row1 eyes open, row2 brief gentle blink with tiny head tilt and belly breathing. Clearly not happy-grinning.
ROWS3-4 THIRSTY two-frame idle: low seated/crouched posture, head a little lowered but raised enough to pant, mouth slightly open with small pink tongue showing, weary half-open eyes. Row3 gentle inhale, row4 soft exhale mouth slightly wider and tongue a little lower; subtle chest motion. Keep nose and body locations nearly identical. No sweat drops, no exaggerated drooling.
ROWS5-6 TIRED two-frame idle: laying on belly with paws extended, chin near front paws, curled tail resting beside body, eyelids heavy. Row5 drowsy half-closed eyes, row6 eyes closed for slow blink, tiny breathing lift only. Not stretched flat unnaturally. Full ears, tail and four paws within each cell.
All six rows must be distinct from the happy standing idle of the reference. Exact same dog identity and costume across rows; keep the pair geometries stable for an actual two-frame animation, not different cameras. High-resolution tall atlas with fully transparent gutters.
transparency_prompt: Remove ONLY all background and ground shadows from this sprite atlas. Make every area outside the 18 dogs fully TRANSPARENT alpha=0 including all white/gray/brown background and gutters, preserving the cream WHITE FUR, ears, paws, tails and costumes intact. Preserve the 3 column 6 row arrangement and ALL poses exactly. Do not redraw expressions or change sizes. No checkerboard drawn, no paper. Clean transparent cutouts of the 18 dogs only.
red_costume_edit_prompt: Edit this TRANSPARENT 18-dog animation atlas: replace the BLUE HARNESS on EVERY dog with a RED TRIANGULAR NECKERCHIEF tied at the side, and remove all harness straps and badges. Preserve the exact 3-column 6-row layout, all 18 dog silhouettes, ages, poses, facial expressions and fur. Keep the transparent background TRANSPARENT alpha=0. Do NOT add ANY backdrop, grey gradient, paper, floor or shadow. Only the red clothing changes; all other pixels/layout unchanged. Clean transparent RGBA sprite atlas.
